items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Alvin Alcon was in that band.

ctx.x: No Larry had the band but- Mmhmm. Mmhmm. Mmhmm.

Mmhmm. Mmhmm. Mmhmm. Was another Larry not here? Jimmy. Jimmy Larry. He did. The, the, the, the cornet player had the band. Larry inherited that band from his brother. Oh. Jimmy Larry had the band. Did you ever hear a Don Albums band? Yeah, I know. They were, they came in, they came here in the early, early thirties too. Alvin Alcon was in that band. Got a trombone player named Geechee. I can't talk about the name of Fernandez. I believe he's from here. Fred Nandese, huh? Yeah, I know something like that. Yeah,…
